text:
alex: quick agenda: finalizing release notes + changelog for docs v0.12.3. Focus: migration guide for embed-streaming removal, tidy SDK snippets (py/js), and fixing stale links. Who can own publish? ping @maya

maya: I’ll own publish & the release blurb. Freeze PRs in 36h. Drop links and any copy-snippet asks here. :clipboard:

sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5482 -- JS/Py snippet parity and removed numeric perf claims. Left `// MIGRATE` tags in examples.

kevin: Found a lingering example using `kestrel:openai/compat` in /examples/chat.md. Replaced with canonical spec and updated the snippet to `rdw.chat.create(...)`.

alex: Also: routing fallback behavioral change needs a one-line note under "Behavioral changes". Draft: "Routing fallback now prioritizes lower-latency compatible model variants; this can change per-request sampling and tail latency." Can someone paste into changelog?

maya: paste incoming. Also: remove ms/token numbers from examples. Keep outputs generic.

sam: Updated my PR to `rdw.text.generate(...)` in JS and `client.text.generate()` in py. Ran smoke tests locally.

kevin: Fixed internal anchor: /docs/perf/caching#kv-cache -> /docs/perf/caching#kv-cache (redirect ensured). Confirmed redirect added to /_redirects.

docs-bot: Release checklist: 1) All PRs linked 2) Snippets smoke-tested 3) Changelog entry added to /changelogs/0.12.3.md 4) Known-issues short bullets included 5) Owner runs `/docs release-ready`.

maya: Known-issues bullets draft: - Sidebar anchor caching may present stale anchors for a short window post-deploy (Netlify SSG cache). - embed-streaming deprecated: migrate to embeddings.v2 or contact SE for Dedicated help. - Python SDK alias `client.generate` deprecated; prefer `client.text.generate`. Keep short.

ops-bot: NOTE: If anchor 404s reported after merge, ops can trigger a short Netlify cache invalidation. Ping `@ops` with the PR link.

sam: ✅ snippet tested (JS + Py) -- smoke tests pass.

maya: I’ll assemble the release blurb and open /changelogs/0.12.3.md PR by EOD tomorrow. If you push late fixes, add a 1-line changelog note to the PR so I can include it.

alex: Thanks all. Publishing window tomorrow 11:45 PT. If anything blocks, flag here early.
